description: Every downward-closed subset of a well-ordered linear order is either the full set or the set of elements strictly below some element.
signature:
IsLowerSet.eq_univ_or_Iio.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] {s : Set α} [WellFoundedLT α] (h : IsLowerSet s) :
  s = Set.univ ∨ ∃ a, s = Set.Iio a
